observation: Fresh main publishes createdAt/updatedAt and receipt.at as date-time fields and every existing writer emits new Date().toISOString(), but the durable read boundary only checked typeof string. A coherently rewritten artifact could therefore carry non-date or impossible timestamps while remaining otherwise structurally and semantically valid.
changes: Add a writer-faithful ISO timestamp validator for durable changeset envelope and receipt timestamps.
Reject non-canonical, impossible or non-date timestamp strings before ordinary readers consume the artifact.
Keep broader ordering/causality semantics separate; this cycle does not invent clock trust, monotonicity or cross-machine temporal policy.
